**Stocks Slide as Tech Selloff Worsens Ahead of Key Events**
Global equities declined due to a technology share selloff prior to upcoming earnings from Nvidia Corp. and Anthropic PBC's expected listing. These two events are anticipated to impact the near-term trajectory of the increasingly volatile AI trade.
